fusions.name: Stoop on Command
fusions.desc: Looses a raptor from the fist at the first enemy in its path; it deals 30 damage and always lands as a critical hit. Its reach is 40% longer.

fusions.name: Mob Rule
fusions.desc: Sends 3 birds at once, spread apart; each deals 6 damage and has a 30% chance to leave its target [Blunted] for 5 seconds. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Alight Where Pointed
fusions.desc: Carries you instantly to a point up to 7 tiles away. Your movement speed rises 15% for 3 seconds afterward.

fusions.name: Falcon on the Fist
fusions.desc: A bonded falcon fights beside you, striking enemies within 5 tiles for 4 damage every 1.2 seconds. Each kill restores 2 health to you.
